AccessField.reason: Access type, mode bits and raw attributes retained; protocol-context validation pending.

BankField.reason: Literal BankValue parsed; dynamic TermArg leaves entire remainder unparsed.

BankValue.TermArg.reason: Unknown operand boundary prevents flags/list decoding; span is explicitly the whole remainder, not a validated TermArg.

ConnectField.Buffer.reason: Complete Buffer encoding retained; literal size/initializer boundary recorded when supported, dynamic inner expression remains opaque.

ConnectField.Name.reason: Lexical connection NameString retained for later scope-aware resolution.

CreateField.family.reason: Separate executable declaration family remains pending; no claim based on FieldList coverage.

ExtendedAccessField.reason: Preserves extended attribute and length; validates reserved type bits and extended attribute codes.

Field.reason: Package, region NameString, flags and bounded list; no region lookup or installation.

FieldUnit.runtime.reason: No runtime field storage, namespace bindings, type resolution, locks, bank/index operations, connections or handlers.

IndexField.reason: Index/data NameStrings retained; register type/width validation and runtime access pending.

NamedField.reason: Exactly one NameSeg plus raw PkgLength bit length; local declaration path and effective metadata retained.

ReservedField.reason: PkgLength bit count advances bounded cumulative cursor.
